summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with a module-scoped Turtle fixture and parametrized tests. Ran with the generator venv: test_shacl_extras.py and test/test_path.py pass (40 tests). Nothing committed; no existing files changed. Not verified: mypy, black, and isort are not in the venv, so the type-ignore placement and formatting were checked by reading only.
